title: Export saved searches
summary: Documentation fixture: export saved-search names and queries as CSV; no export is produced for an empty collection.

normative.title: Export saved searches
normative.summary: Documentation fixture: export saved-search names and queries as CSV; no export is produced for an empty collection.

intent.problem: Saved searches cannot be transferred into a spreadsheet.
intent.outcome: Obtain a correctly quoted CSV export or an explicit empty result.

approach.choice: Use the Python standard-library CSV writer.
approach.tradeoff: CSV preserves the two text fields but does not preserve application metadata.

scope.statement: Export the provided ordered name/query records through one pure function.

non_goals.statement: No authentication, filesystem write, browser download, or live application integration.

criteria.title: Preserve fields and order
criteria.statement: Parsed CSV has name/query headers and one row for each record in input order.
preconditions: Two saved searches with plain text fields.
guarantees: Parsed CSV has name/query headers and one row for each record in input order.

scenarios.given: Two saved searches with plain text fields.
scenarios.then: Parsed CSV has name/query headers and one row for each record in input order.

verification.oracle: Parsed CSV has name/query headers and one row for each record in input order.
verification.negative_control: An implementation returning None for every input fails the export checks.

applicability.rationale: Two saved searches with plain text fields.

criteria.title: Round-trip special characters
criteria.statement: Every field equals the original text after CSV round-trip.
preconditions: A record containing commas, quotes, newlines and Unicode.
criteria.trigger: Export and parse using the standard CSV reader.
guarantees: Every field equals the original text after CSV round-trip.

scenarios.given: A record containing commas, quotes, newlines and Unicode.
scenarios.when: Export and parse using the standard CSV reader.
scenarios.then: Every field equals the original text after CSV round-trip.

verification.oracle: Every field equals the original text after CSV round-trip.
verification.negative_control: An implementation returning None for every input fails the export checks.

applicability.rationale: A record containing commas, quotes, newlines and Unicode.

criteria.title: Keep an empty result explicit
criteria.statement: The function returns None, not a header-only export.
guarantees: The function returns None, not a header-only export.

scenarios.then: The function returns None, not a header-only export.

verification.oracle: The function returns None, not a header-only export.
verification.negative_control: An implementation emitting headers for empty input fails the empty check.
